quest_progress = globals().get('quest_progress') """:type: quest_progress"""
MAIN_PROGRESS_TOP_BY_DAMAGE1 = 'topByDamage1' MAIN_PROGRESS_TOP_BY_DAMAGE2 = 'topByDamage2' MAIN_PROGRESS_HITS_FREQUENCY = 'hitsFrequency'
MAIN_PROGRESS_SERIES1 = 'battlesSeries1' MAIN_PROGRESS_SERIES2 = 'battlesSeries2'
def onInit(eventType, eventData, quest, processor): for event in events.iterkeys(): processor.subscribe(event, quest) return True
def onFinishBattle(eventType, eventData, quest, processor): questProgress = quest_progress.BaseQuestProgress(quest.config, processor.getQuestProgress(quest.progressID))
damagePosition = eventData['avatarResults']['misc']['max']['damageDealt'] if damagePosition <= questProgress.getProgress(MAIN_PROGRESS_TOP_BY_DAMAGE1).getParam('desiredPosition'): questProgress.increaseUntilComplete(MAIN_PROGRESS_SERIES1, 1)
shots = eventData['avatarResults']['shots'] if shots and damagePosition <= questProgress.getProgress(MAIN_PROGRESS_TOP_BY_DAMAGE2).getParam('desiredPosition'): hitsFrequency = eventData['avatarResults']['enemyHits'] * 100. / shots questProgress.increaseSeriesUntilComplete(MAIN_PROGRESS_SERIES2, MAIN_PROGRESS_HITS_FREQUENCY, hitsFrequency)
eventData['results'].update(processor.checkComplete(questProgress, quest.progressID)) processor.setQuestProgress(quest.progressID, questProgress.save())
events = { QUEST_EVENT_TYPE.INIT: onInit, QUEST_EVENT_TYPE.FINISH_BATTLE: onFinishBattle, }
def quest(eventType, eventData, quest, processor): LOG('QUEST EVENT:', eventType, quest.id) return events.get(eventType, lambda *args: False)(eventType, eventData, quest, processor)
